title: Climate Adaptation Market: $1.3 Trillion Opportunity | World Economic Forum
gist: WEF/BCG paper summary: the global market for climate adaptation and resilience products and services is a $1.3 trillion annual opportunity by 2030 — potentially more if latent demand is unlocked — but requires deliberate market-building focused on demand growth in 10 priority subsectors.

insights.claim: The World Economic Forum and Boston Consulting Group estimate the global climate adaptation and resilience market opportunity at $1.3 trillion annually by 2030, with latent demand potentially scaling it further.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Sizes a large addressable market for resilience products (infrastructure hardening, insurance, water, cooling) as a theme distinct from mitigation/decarbonization.
insights.quote: The global opportunity for this market is $1.3 trillion annually by 2030

insights.claim: WEF argues that climate adaptation markets will not emerge on their own but require deliberate market-building to bring products and services to households, businesses and governments.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Policy and regulatory action is the likely catalyst for adaptation demand — watch government and regulator initiatives as leading indicators.

insights.claim: The WEF/BCG report 'The Business of Adaptation' prioritizes demand growth in 10 subsectors that let people and businesses manage their own risk and resilience, aiming for a self-sustaining adaptation marketplace.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Demand-side (self-managed resilience) framing points to consumer and SME-facing adaptation products rather than only public infrastructure.
